eps.ov: With news of Izaya's hospitalization quickly spreading, the information broker is filled with anticipation and excitement about which of his many enemies will make a move on his life.
eps.oa: مع انتشار خبر دخول «إيزايا» المستشفى بسرعة، يمتلئ سمسار المعلومات ترقباً وحماسة: أي أعدائه الكثيرين سيتحرك ليقضي عليه؟

eps.ov: Namie is keeping a close eye on Seiji as he and Mika go on a date.
eps.oa: تراقب «نامي» «سيجي» عن كثب وهو يخرج في موعد مع «ميكا».

eps.ov: The Awakusu Group executive Mizuki Akabayashi, nicknamed the “Red Devil of Awakusu,” hates drugs and keeps a vigilant eye on the trends in the city of Ikebukuro. The reason why he hates drugs goes back six years to the night of a fateful encounter.
eps.oa: يكره «ميزوكي أكاباياشي»، القيادي في «جماعة أواكوسو» الملقب «شيطان أواكوسو الأحمر»، المخدرات، ويراقب بيقظة ما يجري في مدينة «إيكيبوكورو». وسبب كرهه المخدرات يعود إلى ست سنوات، إلى ليلة لقاء مصيري.

eps.t: A Rumor Only Lasts Seventy-Five Days
eps.ov: Rumors spread about “Ikebukuro’s most dangerous man,” claiming things like, “He’s injured. He has a girlfriend. He has a child.” After her defeat by Shizuo, Varona has lost her sense of purpose. At Dennis’ suggestion, she…
eps.ta: الشائعة لا تدوم إلا خمسة وسبعين يوماً
eps.oa: تنتشر شائعات عن «أخطر رجل في إيكيبوكورو» تقول أشياء مثل: «إنه مصاب»، «له حبيبة»، «له طفل». وبعد هزيمتها أمام «شيزوو» فقدت «فارونا» إحساسها بالغاية، فتقرر باقتراح من «دينيس»...

eps.ov: It’s summer, and Anri has begun to worry about Mikado. The popular idol Ruri has been plagued by a malicious stalker. It seems that stalker is in the Dollars. In an attempt to obtain information, Yuhei and Ruri visit Shizuo...
eps.oa: إنه الصيف، وقد بدأت «أنري» تقلق على «ميكادو». ويلاحق الأيدول المحبوبة «روري» متعقب خبيث يبدو أنه من «الدولارز». فيزور «يوهي»، أخو «شيزوو»، وروري شيزوو سعياً إلى معلومات...

eps.ov: He was in love with Ruri Hijiribe. That was the reason why he became a stalker and loved her so intensely that he wanted to destroy her soul. All the suffering Ruri had gone through, and the reason for the killer, Hollywood, will be revealed.
eps.oa: كان يحب «روري هيجيريبي»، ولهذا صار متعقباً، وأحبها حباً جارفاً حتى أراد أن يحطم روحها. وستنكشف كل المعاناة التي مرت بها روري، وسر القاتل «هوليوود».

eps.ov: Everyone involved with Ruri is becoming the target of the stalker. Shizuo and Masaomi find themselves caught up in the action and encounter a member of Blue Square in the midst of it. With Anri in imminent danger, Masaomi seeks out the truth.

eps.t: A Mouth of Nectar, a Heart of Needles
eps.ov: Amphisbaena runs an underground casino, and Heaven’s Slave, a gang of drug dealers. Even then, no one can figure out who these two groups really are. The Awakusu Group hires Izaya to do some digging, but...

Using a number of pseudonyms, Izaya has continued to cause an uproar from behind the scenes. One of these pseudonyms is a story that goes back 12 years ago, from the time he was a middle school student along with Shinra.

Various people begin to move around the Dollars. Learning of Mikado’s current situation, Masaomi revives the Yellow Scarves and in his determination to crush the Dollars, approaches Kyohei. Meanwhile, we learn more of Aoba’s history with his brother.

Kadota was in a hit-and-run and the resulting rumors have Saburo and Walker taking action. In an effort to get information on the Dollars, Shuji Niekawa contacts Haruya Shiki. Meanwhile, Akabayashi follows up with Izaya on his investigation of Mikado.

eps.t: It Takes a Thief to Catch a Thief
eps.ov: Advancing the internal purge of the Dollars, Mikado tries to realize his ideal, which is leading to a clash with the Yellow Scarves. Various incidents are further entangled as another uproar occurs in Ikebukuro, and the story deepens into further chaos!
